title: Four Thousand Words, Two Places To Put The Stress
summary: Build a Latin word one syllable at a time and watch the accent jump when the second-from-last syllable turns heavy. The whole rule is three states read backwards.

sources.title: Allen, Vox Latina: the pronunciation of Classical Latin, 2nd ed., chapter on accent
Hayes, Metrical Stress Theory: Principles and Case Studies
Gordon, Syllable Weight: Phonetics, Phonology, Typology
